snippet.title: 9 Yin Sutra - Immortal | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
9 Yin Sutra - Immortal is an open-world cultivation sandbox blending survival, building, exploration, talisman arts, and artifact crafting.

As spiritual qi rises, all things awaken to the path of cultivation. Step into a vast realm brought to life with Unreal Engine 5, where cultivators from around the world gather to discuss the Dao and seek eternal life. Uncover hidden realms, seize rare opportunities, decipher ancient runes, and refine wondrous treasures. In a world where danger and fortune walk side by side, how far will you go to uncover the secret of immortality?
